correctness.rationale: The seven positions of the (2,2,3) code have exactly Bell(7)=877 symbol-equality partitions. Excluding 52 coincident-short-word patterns leaves 825 complete symbolic cases, for all q. The exact Sardinas-Patterson decision routine independently identifies precisely 10 non-UD patterns, matching the two proved witness families in every case; 815 remaining cases are UD. Literal checks at q=2..5 give 8,30,72,140, confirming the all-q polynomial. The disjoint counting argument and minimum 5-length witness are proved. Residual graph closure is finite and the full checker runs from the package.

value.rationale: The smallest odd long length beyond two length-two messages is a natural delimiter-free coding boundary. The theorem gives a complete classification of the failure population for every q, a sharp universal 5-symbol failure certificate, and a closed failure probability decreasing as \(2/q^4\). Unlike a single check of an arbitrary codebook, the result is a natural whole-profile structural invariant, distinguishing commuting and conjugate collisions; it does not claim other profiles.
